name: agent-lab-evals
description: Pinned Promptfoo runner for Agent Lab local regression suites

scripts.validate: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR="${PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR:-../.agent-lab/promptfoo}" promptfoo validate -c promptfooconfig.yaml && PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR="${PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR:-../.agent-lab/promptfoo}" promptfoo validate -c promptfooconfig.assertion-selftest.yaml
scripts.eval:fast: mkdir -p ../.agent-lab/results ../.agent-lab/promptfoo && OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434 PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR="${PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR:-../.agent-lab/promptfoo}" promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --filter-metadata suite=fast -j 1 --no-share --output ../.agent-lab/results/promptfoo-fast.json
scripts.eval:selftest: mkdir -p ../.agent-lab/results ../.agent-lab/promptfoo && set +e; PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR="${PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR:-../.agent-lab/promptfoo}" promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.assertion-selftest.yaml -j 1 --no-share --output ../.agent-lab/results/promptfoo-assertion-selftest.json; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -ne 0 && node fixtures/assertions/verify-bad-responses.js
